name: Kestra
tagline: Orchestration for data, AI, and infrastructure workflows as declarative YAML.
description: Kestra is an open-source orchestration platform for building data, AI, and infrastructure pipelines as declarative YAML workflows. It is event-driven and language-agnostic, running Python, Bash, Node, Go, or containers across 1,500+ plugins, with a web UI for monitoring plus governance features like RBAC and audit logs. It ships as free self-hosted open source alongside paid Cloud and Enterprise editions.
insight: Raised a $25M Series A in March 2026, bringing its total funding to about $36M.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates any task, including AI/LLM steps; not tied to a model.

edge: Define pipelines as declarative YAML, not Python DAGs, with event triggers and 1,500+ plugins across data, AI, and infra in one engine.
pros: Language-agnostic with a broad plugin set
cons: YAML can get verbose at scale
Advanced features gated to paid tiers

references.title: French open-source orchestration platform Kestra raises $25M
Paris-based Kestra lands €21M Series A for orchestration expansion
